resources.string: Open a verified course download. Reading does not download or send the document to AI.
No saved PDFs available. Download a course PDF from Courses or Offline downloads first.
Notes remain available when a downloaded file is removed or replaced. Old versions stay separate.
No page bookmarks. Bookmark a page while reading to return here later.
Tap the page to place a note pin
A local text note linked to this page and pin. It does not change or highlight text inside the PDF.
Delete this local note? The PDF remains unchanged.
No notes yet. Tap Add note on a page, then choose a pin location.
PDF page %1$d of %2$d. Pinch or double-tap to zoom; drag to pan. Page image is not selectable text.
Pinch or double-tap to zoom · drag to pan
%1$d other saved versions exist. Their notes were kept separate; inspect them in the reading library.
Saved record · page images are not opened. Notes below belong to this exact document version.

Create a JSON file containing the document name/version, reading position, page bookmarks and note text/pins. It contains no PDF bytes, account ID, source URL or credentials. The exported file is outside app storage.
Delete this version’s saved position, page bookmarks and all notes? The original PDF and other versions remain.
The verified PDF is unavailable, changed or exceeds 25 MiB. Verify the local library or download it again from Courses.
This PDF could not be opened. It may be corrupt, password-protected or unsupported. The reader does not request passwords.
This page could not be rendered. Try another page or reopen the document.
Saved reading data could not be read. Existing data is preserved; note editing is disabled until it can be loaded.
The local change could not be saved or the record changed elsewhere. Retry before leaving; your open note draft is retained.
The owning account was removed. Its reading workspace was cleared.
Export could not be completed. Check the destination and that this record’s account is still connected.
Reading limits: 4,000 characters/note, 100 notes and 200 bookmarks/version, 50 versions and 500,000 note characters/account. Remove old records or shorten the note.
One account’s saved reading records could not be read. Other accounts remain available.
Discard unsaved position changes and the open note draft, then load the latest saved record? The PDF stays unchanged.
Close this workspace and its open draft without retrying the save? A previous save may already have completed. The PDF and saved records stay unchanged.
